full_page.content:
Page 271 Apr. 9 Mrs. J. E. Anderson - 80 - fears repetition of operation for cancer.
Page 272
April Loraine Commire - 26 - T. B. feared Marg. Mcclellan - 35 - T. B. operations .... now inclined to insane ... Mrs. Adolph Lock of Cleveland, 0. - 58 - flebitis - swollen limbs etc.
Apr. 13 Theodore Warner - 10 - Infantile paralysis since 8 months old. Two yrs. ago was brought hither, was enrolled and prayed for. Shortly after, had operation on both legs. The worse one formerly is now without brace entirely. Hopes are growing that another operation may relieve him of all braces.
Dorothy Hickey - 25 - unconscious since .... 4 - a week last Friday. Operation for tuomer on the brain ... so interwoven in brain that Drs. say they dare not touch it.
Mary F. Clements - 34 - inward cancer feared - husband , a roofer, fell and was killed two years ago and left her with 6 small children. Her Br. who has 3 of his own is keeping them.
Someone asks for prayers for conversion of brother-in-law - became a hater of religion - causing his wife many a heart ache ...
Page 273 April Mary Mckenna - 43 - had convultion three yrs. ago and seemingly re- ceived a brain injury ... Has had about 25 convultions since. Drs. figuering of operation.
Agnes Matthew - 45 - fearful asthma .... has husband and two Robert Hogan - 67 - fearful throat ulcers. John J. Griffith - 43 - convert
15th Mrs. Macede Laubenheimer - 59 - quite a threatening lump in left breast. Drs. strongly recommend operation. Patient fears ..... Strange - born three month after Catholic father died and was raised Episcopelian.
Dianna Marie O'Byan - 10 mo. larnex trouble since birth .... otherwise bright little child.
